findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "booking_reserve" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a real reservation (action=booking.reserve). No money moves, but A REAL APPOINTMENT IS PLACED AT THE SHOP AND THE PERSON NAME AND PHONE ARE HANDED TO THE…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: reach_read, member_lookup, member_register, guestbook_list · Private data: reach_read, reach_search, guestbook_list · Public sink: member_lookup, member_register, booking_reserve, guestbook_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: reach_read, member_lookup, member_register, guestbook_list · Private data: reach_read, reach_search, guestbook_list · Public sink: member_lookup, member_register, booking_reserve, guestbook_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
